messages:
Priya: FYI: AWS marketplace team asked how we handle multi-SI bundles for a single account (they want a recommended partner on the listing). We need a short policy before Monday.
Marco: is this about co-sell badge placement or lead routing from marketplace purchases?
Priya: both. customer can buy infra + redwood managed services from different SIs. AWS wants a single "recommended" partner but we can't always pick one arbitrarily.
Jen: suggestion: recommend the SI who has an active integration certification + regional enablement. If none, show multiple partners and let customer select.
Carlos: for lead routing we should honor the purchase funnel: upstream signal (marketplace purchase intent) -> route to listing owner partner if they participated in the bundle -> else route to default partner program.
ops-bot: note created: marketplace-copilot-routing #tagged-priority-high
Priya: also need rules for joint announcements (partner + redwood). Some partners want co-branded press immediately; others prefer quiet launches. We need a checklist.
Marco: for announcements: 1) confirm cross-org nomination (partner marketing rep + Redwood GTM rep), 2) legal signoff on co-brand assets, 3) timeline locking (no surprise emails).
Jen: add a data/attribution clause: any leads that come from the marketplace listing within 90 days are considered "attributed" to the partner(s) listed on the bundle, split by lead_share_config.
Carlos: lead_share_config? can we keep it simple: primary partner 70% / secondary partner 30% by default, adjustable per bundle.
Priya: love that. we should default to 100/0 if a partner is the exclusive implementation vendor. For multi-SI bundles, require partner agreement at submission.
Marco: we also need conflict resolution: if two partners claim recommendation on the same listing, escalate to Partnerships Lead (Priya) and temporarily set listing to "recommendation_pending". Partners get notified.
marketplace-bot: event: `bundle.recommendation.claimed` -> partners notified; listing status changed to recommendation_pending.
Jen: sample JSON for lead attribution I'd propose (for devs and ops):
```json
{
  "bundle_id": "bundle_987",
  "partners": [
    {"partner_id": "p_alpha","role":"primary","share_percent":70},
    {"partner_id": "p_beta","role":"secondary","share_percent":30}
  ],
  "attribution_window_days": 90,
  "announcement_policy": "coordinated_opt_in"
}
```
Carlos: ops question: how do we surface attribution to partners? SF lead records with `origin_bundle` and `partner_shares` fields? partners should see a weekly summary CSV in the partner portal.
Priya: yes: SF + partner portal summary. Also add an opt-out toggle for partners who don't want attribution/marketing.
Marco: action items: (1) Priya draft the marketplace bundle policy + announcement checklist (2) Jen create lead_share_config schema and example payloads (3) Carlos hook partner portal CSV export (4) Marco add recommendation_pending state to listing workflow.
Jen: I'll open a repo issue with sample webhooks and the share schema.
Carlos: I'll prototype the CSV export and a nightly job to surface attributions.
Priya: I'll circulate the announcement checklist and require partner sign-off before any co-branded PR. Need it by Fri COB.
Marco: once policy exists we can tell AWS we prefer to show up to 3 recommended partners with clear roles and a "why recommended" blurb.
Priya: thanks all — want to avoid surprises for partners and customers. tagging @here for any objections. :sparkles:
